ignoreValues.reason: False positive: .lede sets line-height 1.4 on clamp(18px, 2vw, 22px). The static cascade resolves 1.4 against a 16px base (22.4px) because clamp() font-size is unresolved, then scores the font as 18, reporting 1.24. Used leading in a browser is 1.4, above the 1.3 gate.

False positive: .how padding is clamp(16px, 4vw, 48px) so the inset is at least 16px; the static engine cannot parse clamp() and treats it as 0. The Setup-required strip cell is flagged by merging desktop border-left:1px with the max-width 560px rule padding-left:0, which do not apply together.
False positive: evidence display sizes are clamp() (h1 36-64px, h2 32-48px) and the static collector drops unresolved clamp(), leaving 13/18/20px (ratio 1.5). Rendered max/min is at least 36/13.
